title: Waystones issue #1167: [Bug] The visibility option for Sharestone doesn't work.
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (NOASSERTION) does not cover issue text
text: [issue by MapleSugar365] ### Minecraft Version 1.21.1 ### Mod Loader NeoForge ### Describe the Issue When placed, Sharestone seems to be activated for all players by default, rendering the "Visible upon Activation" visibility option ineffective. If, with the Sharestone's visibility option set to "Visible upon Activation", other players had to activate it like a Waystone before it would appear in the teleport list of Sharestones of the same color, I think this would be a great feature on servers and could open up additional gameplay mechanics. ### Logs The game did not crash, but as requested, here is the provided information:[latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28264789/latest.log) [comment by BlayTheNinth (member)] The "activation" visibility showing up is a bug that has now been fixed. Activation for sharestones is not intended or planned.
